PreceptDef.label: forbidden
PreceptDef.description: Ending a pregnancy is considered a serious violation. Patients and surgeons who hold this belief suffer a mood penalty after termination. Performing it on a foreign patient who holds this belief costs 35 goodwill with their home faction. The surgery remains available.

PreceptDef.label: accepted
PreceptDef.description: Pregnancy termination is an accepted procedure, and the decision belongs to the individual. This belief adds no warning or mood penalty.

PreceptDef.label: no preference
PreceptDef.description: Pregnancy termination is treated as a private medical matter rather than a moral issue.
